purpose: Mechanism-only live smoke test before opening any new development case.
claim_scope: This consumed-case run may validate the live session and replay plumbing but cannot support an effectiveness or generalization claim.

case_source.selection_reason: duckdb_engine previously exposed construction-success versus clean-replay failure and is therefore diagnostic for the Minimal B mechanism

outcome_rules.live_mechanism_pass: generation completes with at least one replay and an accepted passing certificate
outcome_rules.official_pass: report separately as a smoke result, not an effectiveness estimate
outcome_rules.infrastructure_failure: rerun the identical frozen episode only after recording an amendment
outcome_rules.mechanism_failure: do not open a new case; repair using synthetic or this consumed evidence and create a new implementation freeze

next_decision: Only after the live mechanism passes may a repository-disjoint paired development protocol be preregistered.
